==Description==
This template provides detailed information about the in-universe date placement of game updates for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.

==Usage==
Use <code><nowiki>{{TOR_updates|patch}}</nowiki></code> as part of a [[Wookieepedia:Sourcing|reference note]] citing the in-universe year. For example, <code><nowiki>{{TOR_updates|6.3}}</nowiki></code> refers to Game Update 6.3: ''The Dark Descent'' and produces:

<blockquote>
{{TOR_updates|6.3}}
</blockquote>
